detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name, COUNT(le.event_id) AS failed_attempts, 
       t.txn_type, t.amount, t.amount_usd, t.status, t.flag_reason 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE UPPER(le.ip_address) IN (
  SELECT le2.ip_address 
  FROM login_events le2 
  JOIN login_events le3 ON le2.ip_address = le3.ip_address 
  WHERE UPPER(le3.status) = 'FAILED' 
  GROUP BY le2.ip_address 
  HAVING COUNT(le3.event_id) > 10 
  AND le3.created_at >= date('now', '-28 days')
) 
AND t.txn_type IN (
  SELECT t2.txn_type 
  FROM transactions t2 
  GROUP BY t2.txn_type 
  HAVING COUNT(t2.txn_id) > 25 
  AND t2.created_at >= date('now', '-90 days')
) 
GROUP BY u.full_name, t.txn_type, t.amount, t.amount_usd, t.status, t.flag_reason

detections.sql:
SELECT 
  le.country, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as total_users, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN u.user_id END) as failed_payments, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN u.user_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) as failure_rate
FROM 
  users u 
  JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id

  AND t.status = 'FAILED' 
  AND t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
GROUP BY 
  le.country
ORDER BY 
  failure_rate DESC

detections.mission_name: User Performance Issues in Transaction Volume
detections.sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t1.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t2.txn_count END) as avg_txn_count, 
       u.full_name, 
       u.user_id, 
       t1.user_id as user_id_with_decrease, 
       (t2.txn_count - t1.txn_count) / t1.txn_count * 100 as percentage_decrease
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= date('now', '-90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as txn_count
  FROM transactions
  GROUP BY user_id
) t2
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT user_id, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as txn_count
  FROM transactions
  GROUP BY user_id
) t1 ON t2.user_id = t1.user_id
JOIN users u ON t2.user_id = u.user_id
